sections.title: How does one request pass through a Provider and become a model result?
sections.body: 1 · Local config config.toml config.toml 1 provider = "openrouter" 2 model = "deepseek-v4-flash" 3 base_url = "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1" The tool reads who to call and which model to use. → send 2 · Actual request OpenRouter API POST /chat/completions https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 model: deepseek-v4-flash The request reaches OpenRouter, not the model name. → return 3 · Observable result 200 OK Terminal $ OpenRouter model: deepseek-v4-flash answer: button code returned The Provider returns the model result to the tool. Provider is the service platform in the request path; Model is the specific capability selected in that request.

sections.title: How to tell a Provider from a Model
sections.body: Use a chef to understand a Provider : Imagine you are looking for a chef to cook a dish: the Model is the chef who actually cooks, the Provider is the restaurant or platform that provides the chef and service, the API is the counter where you place an order, the API Key is the membership card that proves you are allowed to order, and the Base URL is the restaurant's address. So, the Provider is who you use to access an AI model. What do Provider and Model mean in a configuration? : provider: openai with model: gpt-5 means using gpt-5 through OpenAI. provider: deepseek with model: deepseek-chat means using deepseek-chat through DeepSeek. In short: the Provider is who supplies the service, and the Model is which model you select. If the configured Provider is openai-compatible , it usually means that the service platform accepts a request format similar to OpenAI. It does not prove that the request goes to OpenAI; check the Base URL, key issuer, and billing party to identify the actual service platform.

zhSections.title: 一次请求怎样通过 Provider 变成模型结果
zhSections.body: 1 · 本地配置 config.toml config.toml 1 provider = "openrouter" 2 model = "deepseek-v4-flash" 3 base_url = "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1" 工具先读取要通过谁调用，以及要使用哪个模型。 → 按配置发送 2 · 实际请求 OpenRouter API POST /chat/completions https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 model: deepseek-v4-flash 请求实际到达 OpenRouter；模型名只是这次调用的目标。 → 返回结果 3 · 可观察结果 200 OK Terminal $ OpenRouter model: deepseek-v4-flash answer: 返回按钮代码 Provider 把模型生成的结果返回给工具。 Provider 是请求链路中的服务平台；Model 是这次请求选中的具体模型。

zhSections.title: Provider 和 Model 的区别
zhSections.body: 用厨师来理解 Provider ： 你想找厨师做一道菜：Model 是真正做菜的厨师，Provider 是提供厨师和服务的餐厅或平台，API 是你向餐厅下单的窗口，API Key 是证明你有权点餐的会员卡，Base URL 是餐厅的地址。所以，Provider 就是你通过谁来使用 AI 模型。 Provider 和 Model 在配置中分别表示什么 ： 配置 provider: openai 、 model: gpt-5 ，表示通过 OpenAI 使用 gpt-5；配置 provider: deepseek 、 model: deepseek-chat ，表示通过 DeepSeek 使用 deepseek-chat。可以简单理解为：Provider 是“谁提供服务”，Model 是“具体使用哪个模型”。如果配置里的 Provider 写成 openai-compatible ，通常只说明服务平台接受类似 OpenAI 的请求格式，并不代表请求一定发给 OpenAI；还要结合 Base URL、API Key 发放方和账单方判断真正的服务平台。

sections.title: How does an API proxy complete one model call?
sections.body: You Starts the call through an AI tool Proxy relay Forwards requests and results Provider Runs the model and generates the result → send request ← return to you → forward request ← return result The request travels to the model provider through the relay, and the result comes back through the same relay.

sections.title: Why can a relay create privacy risks?
sections.body: Both the request and response pass through the relay : The prompt, context, file fragments, and any credential sent with the request may reach the relay first. The Provider's response also passes through the relay before reaching the tool. Public information only makes a service easier to verify : A published operator, official documentation, and service terms make boundaries, billing, and privacy policies easier to inspect, but do not make a platform inherently trustworthy. If a third party handles the request, still verify retention, key handling, and the upstream service. Unknown services carry greater risk : Some unofficial relays may assemble access through account pools or reverse proxies. If a service records requests, changes responses, or injects content, the AI tool usually cannot audit how that relay handles your data. Do not send keys, source code, or sensitive business data to an unknown relay.

zhDescription: API 代理是位于客户端和上游 API 之间，代为接收和转发请求与响应的中间服务。 例如 AI 工具把请求发给中转站，再由它转给模型提供方；结果也沿同一路径返回。中转站可以负责鉴权、路由或统一入口，但不代表模型运行在那里。提示词、文件片段和凭证可能经过它，因此使用前要核对运营主体、隐私政策、数据留存和 Key 的签发方。…

zhSections.title: API 代理如何完成一次模型调用
zhSections.body: 个人 通过 AI 工具发起调用 中转站 接收并转发请求和结果 模型提供商 运行模型并生成结果 → 发送请求 ← 返回给个人 → 转发请求 ← 返回结果 请求经过中转站到达模型提供商，结果再沿着同一条中转链路返回个人。

zhSections.title: 为什么中转站有隐私风险
zhSections.body: 请求和返回都会经过中转站 ： 请求中的提示词、上下文、文件片段，以及可能随请求发送的凭证，会先到达中转站；Provider 返回的内容也会经过中转站后再到工具。 公开信息只让服务更容易核验 ： 有公开运营主体、官方文档和服务条款的平台，更容易检查服务边界、计费和隐私政策，但这不等于它天然可信。只要请求经过第三方，就要继续核对数据留存、密钥处理和上游服务。 来源不明的服务风险更高 ： 有些非正规中转站可能通过号池、反向代理等方式拼接调用资源；如果它记录请求、篡改返回或注入内容，AI 工具通常无法替你审核它的数据处理行为。因此不要把密钥、源码和敏感业务数据交给来源不明的中转站。

sections.title: What do a config file and project rules each control?
sections.body: Config files store runtime settings (JSON / YAML / TOML) : Stores provider, model, endpoint, port, or permission parameters. Common formats include JSON (strict key-value), YAML (supports comments), and TOML (clear sections). sections.title: How does a real answer return after “Who owns issue #1024?”
sections.body: 1 Ask a question 2 Discover the tool 3 Send the lookup 4 Check permission 5 Show the result User question “Who owns issue #1024?” Host AI app MCP Client inside the application → Waiting to select a tool MCP Server Ticket service get_ticket External system Ticket system Stores the real issues Current status The external system has not been accessed Waiting for result The user states what to look up; the AI application receives the question and decides which connections are available. MCP standardizes tool discovery and calls; the external system still owns real data and access control.

sections.title: Who does what in one get_ticket lookup?
sections.body: Configuring and exposing tools : Add server command configs in your AI tool settings. The MCP server announces which tools (like get_ticket) it exposes and what arguments they expect. The AI application requests the call : The model proposes get_ticket({ id: 1024 }), and the MCP client sends it to the issue service. The issue tracker returns the real record : It checks the test account's read access and returns the owner. MCP does not store the issue or decide permission.

sections.title: What does a sandbox do?

description: The property that related operations either all take effect or none of them does. When two people buy the last item at the same time, checking and deducting inventory…

sections.title: How can the final item stay correct under concurrent requests?
sections.body: Read then write Atomic update Verify result Inventory decrement 1 item left Request A reads 1 Request B also reads 1 final stock may be decremented twice Evidence Both requests observe the same old value Separated read and write expose an intermediate state.

sections.title: How the case moves from failure to a verifiable result
sections.body: Problem and key mechanism : When two requests read the last item separately from deducting it, both may believe they can succeed; make the check and deduction one indivisible action so only the request that still meets the condition decrements stock and the other fails as a whole. How to observe the improvement : The other request should fail completely with an out-of-stock response, without producing a second successful order. Then verify that remaining inventory, the successful order count, and the failure feedback all agree. Claiming a support ticket also needs atomicity : When two agents claim the same ticket, checking that it is unassigned and assigning the owner must be one atomic operation. Only one agent succeeds; the other is told it was already claimed.

zhSections.title: 这个案例怎样从失败变成可验收结果
zhSections.body: 问题与关键机制 ： 两个请求同时读取最后一件库存时，分开的读取和扣减可能让两边都认为能成功；把检查和扣减作为一个不可分割的操作，只有仍满足条件的请求完成扣减，另一请求整体失败。 怎样观察改善 ： 另一个请求应当明确失败并收到库存不足提示，不能产生第二张成功订单。最后核对库存、成功订单数和失败反馈是否彼此一致。 领取客服工单也需要原子性 ： 两名客服同时领取同一工单时，检查“未领取”和写入负责人必须是一个原子操作；只能一人成功，另一人收到已被领取。

sections.title: How a process boundary changes failure scope
sections.body: Problem and key mechanism : When web requests and image work share one process, an image-worker crash can stop the site; send image jobs to a separate process through a queue or pipe so the OS manages resources and exit states separately and the failure returns to job status. Verify the failure boundary : Crash the image process and confirm the web process still responds while the job fails or retries. Communication and durable state still need design. sections.title: Why shared memory needs synchronization
sections.body: Problem and key mechanism : When two threads in one process read and write a shared cache at the same time, a later write can overwrite an earlier result; after confirming the shared object and thread relationship, use a lock, queue, or immutable result to order writes and record observable state. Verify stable shared results : Repeated concurrent runs should keep the correct final value. Threads still share the process failure and memory boundary. Video export also uses shared threads : When a video exporter processes segments on multiple threads, they share one progress counter. Updates must be synchronized to prevent regressions or missed progress.

sections.title: How one report export moves through a message queue
sections.body: Before: the page waits for all background work : After the user clicks Export, one request queries data, builds the file, and uploads it. A slow step can leave the page spinning or time out, and the user has no durable task status to check later. Enqueue the work and return status through one task ID : The API creates export_104, enqueues its parameters and ID, and returns that ID. A worker marks the same task processing, then stores either a file location or readable failure. The page shows queued, processing, completed, or failed under that ID. Enqueued means accepted, not completed. Verify evidence across the whole path : Match export_104 across the API response, queued message, worker log, and final UI state. Retry a failed task and confirm duplicate delivery does not create two files. A single 'message enqueued' log does not prove completion.

zhSections.title: 消息队列如何暂存任务并平稳分发
zhSections.body: 提交导出 任务入队 查看结果 报表导出任务 阶段 1 · 同步处理导致等待 任务编号：未生成 导出页面 点击“导出账单” 消息队列 尚未接入 生成文件 占用当前请求处理 页面状态 持续等待，可能超时 可观察证据 请求在文件生成期间一直未结束，页面没有可供后续查询的任务编号 耗时工作和页面请求绑在一起；一旦等待中断，用户难以判断任务是否仍在继续。

zhSections.title: 一次报表导出怎样经过消息队列
zhSections.body: 失败前：页面一直等后台做完 ： 用户点击导出后，请求同时查询数据、生成文件并上传存储。只要其中一步很慢，页面就会长时间转圈甚至超时，而且用户拿不到一个可以继续查询的任务状态。 接入队列，并用任务编号反馈状态 ： 接口创建 export_104，把参数和编号写入队列后返回页面；工作进程领取它时更新为处理中，成功则记录文件地址，失败则记录可读原因。页面始终用同一个编号显示排队中、处理中、已完成或失败。入队只表示已受理，不表示文件已经生成。 改善证据：四处记录能够对上 ： 验收时核对接口响应、队列消息、工作进程日志和页面最终状态都包含 export_104。还要重试一次失败任务，确认不会因重复消费生成两份文件；只有一条“消息已入队”日志不能证明任务完成。

sections.title: Queue acceptance is not task completion
sections.body: Avoid blocking the request : If the upload request performs transcoding directly, the user waits and a processing failure can look like an upload failure. Enqueueing accepts the task and returns its ID first. Bring status back : A later processor updates queued, processing, completed, or failed state. The page looks up those results with the task ID; failures can be retried or reported under the system rules. Improvement is observable : The upload request finishes sooner, status changes are visible, and failures are tied to a task. Enqueueing still does not promise FIFO order or exactly-once processing.

sections.title: How should a payment callback take effect only once when delivered twice?
sections.body: Concurrent delivery Atomic claim Reuse result Payment webhook record event pay_928 first webhook creates payment record concurrent webhook starts at the same time order amount recorded twice Evidence Two handlers receive the same event together Repeating the operation changes the target result.

sections.title: How the case moves from failure to a verifiable result
sections.body: Replace duplicate handling with an atomic claim : The provider may deliver event evt_7f2 concurrently. The server identifies one business action by its event id and uses a unique constraint or equivalent operation to claim processing atomically. Other requests only read the in-progress or saved result without creating or charging again. How to observe the improvement : Give both first and repeated callbacks a clear result so the caller can stop retrying. After delivering the event concurrently, verify that there is still one order, one payment state change, and a matching trace record. Another case: repeated form submission : When a slow network makes someone click Create project several times, the client can reuse one idempotency key for that creation. The server atomically claims the key and reuses the first result instead of creating multiple projects.

sections.title: How two inventory requests own, wait for, and release a lock
sections.body: Enter together One owner Complete in order Inventory record lock stock_9 = 1 Request A reads and decrements Request B reads concurrently final stock may become -1 Evidence Two workers enter the critical section The shared record has no access order.

sections.title: How a lock orders access to a shared record
sections.body: Problem and key mechanism : Both requests can read stock 1 and decrement it, causing overselling; lock the shared inventory record so one request checks and updates while the other waits and then rechecks. Verify the waiter rechecks : Concurrent testing yields one success, one out-of-stock result, and final stock 0. Cross-instance scope and deadlock still need handling. A second scenario: clinic scheduling : When two staff members schedule the same clinic room and time slot, the lock should cover that shared slot. sections.title: How to turn an occasional race into reproducible evidence
sections.body: Problem and key mechanism : Both requests start from one coupon, and different read-write interleavings sometimes issue two; have the concurrent test record each read and write's request ID, value, and time so timing evidence returns to the same run. description: A circuit breaker cuts off a repeatedly failing dependency, fails fast or degrades, and probes recovery later. When a checkout page calls a payment dependency that…

sections.title: How a breaker stops a dependency failure from spreading
sections.body: Closed Open Half-Open Order service calling payments Normal forwarding order request passes breaker payment service 200 OK breaker Closed Evidence Success and latency remain within threshold Requests pass while the dependency is healthy.

sections.title: Three states decide whether calls continue
sections.body: Problem and key mechanism : Repeated dependency timeouts or failures accumulate waiting and resource use at the caller; after crossing the threshold, the circuit breaker moves from Closed to Open for fast failure or fallback, then allows only a small probe in Half-Open after a pause. Feedback decides recovery : A successful probe returns to Closed; a failed probe opens the circuit again. The caller is protected, but the breaker does not repair or guarantee the dependency. A second scenario: weather lookup : A trip page depends on an external weather API. After repeated failures, it can temporarily return a cached forecast with its update time and stop calling the dependency, then use a few probes before restoring normal lookup.

description: Backpressure sends a downstream slowdown or pause signal upstream to limit new or unfinished work. If an image-processing service can finish only a small number of…

sections.title: Further reading
sections.body: Flow Control RabbitMQ ↗

sections.title: Why send a downstream slowdown back to the upstream?
sections.body: Producer too fast Signal slowdown Hold a bound Event-processing queue 10,000 msg/s producer keeps full speed consumer handles 2,000/s queue memory keeps growing Evidence Input rate stays above processing rate Without feedback, pending work fills memory.

sections.title: Backpressure makes work follow processing capacity
sections.body: Problem and key mechanism : When uploads outpace image processing, queue length, unfinished work, and memory rise; when downstream slows or reaches its limit, the system sends that feedback upstream so the producer slows down, pauses, or temporarily stops accepting work. Judge improvement by recovery evidence : After a simulated peak, queue and memory should stay bounded and publishing should resume when capacity returns. Backpressure does not add capacity or become a fixed rate rule. Financial report exports also need backpressure : During a bulk report export, data reading may outpace file writing. As the writer nears its capacity limit, it tells the reader to pause and resume after space is available, preventing the export process from exhausting memory as its buffer grows.

sections.title: How two schedulers avoid running one job at the same time
sections.body: Compete Hold and renew Expire and take over Billing-job leader lease Daily at 09:00 instance A ready to bill instance B also ready duplicate risk may run twice Evidence Both instances observe the same schedule Without coordination, the job can run twice.

sections.title: A lease limits ownership by time
sections.body: Control takeover with renewal and expiry : Without coordination, both schedulers can start the daily summary. A lease lets only the current holder run and renew ownership. If it fails or disconnects, a waiting instance must wait for expiry before acquiring a new lease and taking over. Verify the old-holder risk : Each successful takeover receives a larger fencing token, and the database or target service compares it atomically when accepting a write. Pause A through expiry, let B take over, then resume A and verify that A's stale write is rejected. Another case: controller leadership : When several controllers can update the same resources, a lease can elect the current leader and be renewed. After failure, a new controller takes over with a newer token so the old leader cannot keep submitting changes.

sections.title: How one checkout crosses nodes and encounters partial failure
sections.body: Cross-service call Partial network failure Reconcile Orders and inventory across nodes Create order traffic / network order-api writes order_42 network calls inventory inventory-api ready to decrement Evidence Nodes exchange information over the network One user action spans independent runtime nodes.

sections.title: Why a distributed system is harder to judge
sections.body: The network splits one action into independent outcomes : After the order service sends an inventory request, inventory may have processed it, not received it, or processed it while the response was lost. Do not treat order-service success as proof that checkout completed; preserve the cross-service request identity and each result. Return feedback to the same business operation : After an inventory timeout, use the request ID to determine what happened on both sides, then choose waiting, retrying, compensating, or informing the user. Verify a normal request and an unreachable-service request after the fix; these mechanisms improve judgment and recovery but do not remove network failure. Online meeting transcription is also distributed : The recording service may have saved the audio while the transcription service returned nothing after a network timeout. Record the saved-audio and transcription states under the same meeting ID so the system can retry transcription instead of asking the user to record again.

sections.title: What to see clearly in single-instance deployment
sections.body: The only replica defines the availability window : When one running instance handles the service, a release, crash, or maintenance event leaves no other replica of the same service to take over requests. Brief unavailability during restart is an expected risk; a successful deployment job does not mean users remain continuously connected. Move required state out of process memory : Unfinished work in process memory may disappear when the instance stops, while records in durable storage can be read again after recovery. Verify service recovery, durable data, and which in-memory tasks may be lost separately. This improves recovery evidence but does not give one instance automatic failover. An internal room-booking service can run as one instance : A low-traffic internal room-booking service can run as one instance for a simpler deployment. However, every booking entry point becomes briefly unavailable during a release, so choose an acceptable maintenance window and state this risk clearly.

zhDescription: 在运行环境中仅为某个服务保留单个运行副本，所有流量由该唯一实例处理的部署形态。 例如后台服务配置副本数为 1，所有请求暂时由同一个实例处理；发布或崩溃触发重启时，服务可能短暂不可用，未写入持久存储的内存任务也可能丢失。单实例不是单例模式，也不等于数据不能持久化：它描述运行副本数量，数据库或其他持久存储仍可独立存在。…

zhSections.body: ReplicaSet Kubernetes ↗

zhSections.title: 只有一个实例时，请求和重启风险集中在哪里
zhSections.body: 一个副本 实例重启 恢复服务 单实例 Web 服务 replicas = 1 流量 / 网络 负载入口 全部到 web-1 web-1 Healthy 备用实例 不存在 可观察证据 平台显示运行副本数为 1 结构简单，但所有实时流量依赖同一个实例。

zhSections.title: 单实例部署要先看清什么
zhSections.body: 唯一副本决定了可用性窗口 ： 服务只有一个运行实例时，发布、崩溃或维护期间没有其他副本可以接管服务请求。重启期间出现短暂不可用是预期风险，不应把部署任务成功误认为用户始终可访问。 把必须保留的状态移出进程内存 ： 实例停止后，进程内存里的未完成任务可能消失；数据库或其他持久存储中的记录则可以在服务恢复后重新读取。验收要分别检查服务是否恢复、持久化数据是否还在，以及哪些内存任务允许丢失；这样能改善恢复判断，但不能让单实例自动拥有故障接管能力。 内部会议室预约也可以单实例运行 ： 访问量很小的内部预约服务可以只运行一个实例，部署更简单；但发布时所有预约入口会一起短暂不可用，因此应选择可接受的维护时段并明确这项风险。

sections.title: What multi-instance deployment adds and leaves open
sections.body: Multiple instances share requests and offer takeover : An entry point can route requests to several equivalent service instances; when one is maintained or fails, other healthy instances may continue serving traffic. Verify replica count and routing against the service goal instead of trusting a deployment page that merely lists processes. Cross-request state cannot hide in one instance : If a user's first request reaches instance-a and the next reaches instance-b, b cannot identify the user when the session exists only in a's memory. Put session state and similar data in shared or external storage, then route the same user to different instances and verify the session remains valid. This still does not prove database high availability or correct business coordination. Scheduled reports reveal another multi-instance issue : After a daily-report service scales to multiple instances, each instance may trigger the same report at the same time. Coordinate through a shared task record or a single-execution rule so the report is not generated and sent more than once.

zhSections.title: 多实例部署增加了什么、还缺什么
zhSections.body: 多个实例分担请求并提供接管机会 ： 入口可以把请求分到多个相同服务实例；一个实例维护或故障时，其他健康实例仍可能接收请求。副本数和分配方式要与真实服务目标一起验证，不能只看部署页面显示了几个进程。 跨请求状态不能藏在单个实例里 ： 用户第一次请求落到 instance-a、下一次落到 instance-b 时，若会话只在 a 的本地内存，b 就无法识别用户。把会话等状态放到共享或外置存储后，分别让同一用户命中不同实例并确认仍保持登录状态，才能证明改善有效；这仍不代表数据库自动高可用或业务协调已经正确。 定时报表会暴露另一种多实例问题 ： 日报服务扩到多个实例后，每个实例都可能同时触发同一份报表。要用共享任务记录或唯一执行规则协调，避免同一份日报被重复生成和发送。

sections.title: What PostgreSQL does in a project
sections.body: Software, data and instructions : A Database stores organized data; PostgreSQL is the software managing it; SQL is the language used to query, write and define constraints. The backend executes instructions through a database connection and the page displays the result. Configure rules for the business : A foreign key checks whether the referenced user exists. sections.title: What else can a hash help you check?
sections.body: Matching and differing digests : With the same algorithm, encoding, and other conditions, identical contents yield identical digests. Different digests show different inputs. Matching digests can still be a collision, especially after truncation. A full SHA-256 hex digest has 64 digits; other algorithms can have different lengths. Downloads and Git : Compare a download using the same algorithm against a digest from a trusted channel. If both file and comparison value are replaced, a match does not prove authenticity. Git hashes objects; commit contents also include parent commits and commit metadata. A short hash must distinguish the object within the current repository.

zhSections.title: 哈希还能用来判断什么
zhSections.body: 相同与不同 ： 在算法、编码等条件相同时，相同内容得到相同摘要；摘要不同说明输入不同。摘要相同仍可能是碰撞，截短后更不能保证唯一。SHA-256 的完整十六进制摘要是 64 位；其他算法的长度可能不同。 文件校验与 Git ： 下载文件后，可用同一算法与可信渠道公布的摘要比较；如果文件和所谓的校验值一起被替换，比对相同也不能证明来源可信。Git 用哈希标识对象，提交的内容还包含父提交和提交信息等；短哈希需要在当前仓库中足以区分对象。

sections.title: Which operations affect the original contents?
sections.body: Editing contents versus changing targets : Updating draft.theme.mode changes the object it reaches. Assigning a different object to draft only changes that name’s target; it does not rewrite the original object. Assigning primitive values such as numbers also differs from sharing mutable objects. Shallow copying isolates only the first level : { ...original } creates a new outer object, but theme still points to the original theme object. Updating draft.theme.mode therefore still affects the original. Unlike direct assignment, the outer objects are now separate. What pointers mean in Git : A Git branch records its target commit. Usually HEAD points to the current branch, which points to a commit. This is a target-recording analogy, not a memory address. Switching branches also updates working-tree files and may be blocked by uncommitted edits. Not duplicating the whole project does not mean files remain unchanged.

zhSections.title: 哪些操作会影响原来的内容
zhSections.body: 修改内容与换个指向 ： 修改 draft.theme.mode 会改变它指向的对象；把 draft 重新赋成另一个对象，只是让这个名字换个目标，不会因此改写原对象。数字等基本值的赋值也不同于共用可修改对象。 浅拷贝只隔离第一层 ： 用 { ...original } 得到新的外层对象，但里面的 theme 仍指向原来的主题对象。因此修改 draft.theme.mode 仍会影响原配置；它与直接赋值的区别是外层已经独立。 Git 里的指针是什么意思 ： Git 分支记录当前指向的提交；通常 HEAD 指向当前分支，分支再指向提交。这是记录目标的类比，不是内存地址。切换分支还会更新工作区文件，未提交改动可能阻止切换；无需另复制整个项目，不等于文件不会变化。

title: Stack Trace in Web Development Explained | VibeHub
description: The position list printed when a program fails, ordered from the failure point back to the entry. In JavaScript and Node.js, a stack trace commonly lists the frame…

sections.title: Further reading
sections.body: What is a stack trace? MDN ↗ Node.js Errors: Error stack traces Node.js ↗

sections.title: Click each frame to see which line of your code it points to
sections.body: Terminal $ node save.js save.js:24 return items.map((row) => row); ^ TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'map') Your file at loadRows (save.js:24:21) Your file at handleSave (save.js:5:20) Runtime at processTicksAndRejections (node:internal/…) save.js Line 24 4 function handleSave(request) { 5 const items = loadRows(request.file); 6 return items.map((row) => row.total); 7 } 22 function loadRows(file) { 23 const items = readFile(file); 24 return items.map((row) => row); 25 } This is your own file: items is undefined and line 24 calls .map on it. Start here. A stack trace usually lists the frame nearest the throw first, followed by its callers. Start near the top and find a frame in your own file; frames locate clues but do not prove the root cause.

sections.title: How to read a stack trace
sections.body: The frame near the throw is usually near the top : The frame nearest the throw is usually near the top, followed by its callers; a runtime or third-party frame may appear first. Look for your own files only : The trace can mix in runtime and third-party library internals. Only frames from your own files correspond to code you wrote and can be a starting point for a fix. The error type points at a value : TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined means code tried to read a property from undefined; check the failing line and actual data to find which value was undefined.

name: Timeout in Web Development Explained | VibeHub
title: Timeout in Web Development Explained | VibeHub
description: The maximum time to wait for a result before giving up and reporting failure. When a save action ends in 'Request timed out', the page has reached a wait limit; this…

sections.title: Further reading
sections.body: HTTP Semantics: 408 and request waiting RFC Editor ↗ 408 Request Timeout MDN ↗

sections.title: Change one wait limit and see whether the page gets a response
sections.body: Limit 3s Limit 10s Limit 30s Save note Move the weekly meeting to Thursday afternoon. Page timed out; verify the save result The request was sent; the server may still be processing Timeline for this request The response arrives at 12s Limit 3s Response 12s In this example the request reached the service; the page reports a timeout first, while the service may continue and write later. This timeline assumes the request reached the service; other timeouts may happen during connection or sending. Identify the timed-out stage before choosing a limit.

sections.title: What happens when a timeout fires
sections.body: The waiting side gives up : When a wait phase exceeds its limit, the page or tool stops waiting and reports a timeout. If the request reached the service, work may continue there; a connection or send timeout can happen before the service receives the request. A timeout is not an error verdict : A slow response, a busy server, or large data can all exceed the limit. The failure signal only says no result arrived; the cause still needs timing and logs. Different from rate limiting : Rate limiting rejects too many requests per period and returns 429 quickly. A timeout means waiting a long time with no response. They need different handling.

zhSections.title: 超时发生时发生了什么
zhSections.body: 等待端主动放弃 ： 等待某个阶段超过上限时，页面或工具会停止等待并报告超时。本例请求已到服务端；其他超时可能发生在连接、发送或读取阶段。 超时不等于出错 ： 响应慢、服务器忙、数据量大都可能超过上限。失败信号只说明“等不到结果”，原因仍要结合耗时和日志判断。 和限流区分开 ： 限流是单位时间请求太多，很快返回 429；超时是等了很久仍没有响应。两者要分开处理。

description: Reset moves the current branch and handles changes by mode; revert adds a commit that offsets an earlier change. Suppose B adjusts navigation and C accidentally adds a…

sections.title: Anatomy
sections.body: HEAD Back to here 1 Commit to undo Reset moves the branch pointer so the commit is no longer in that branch's later history; whether its changes remain depends on the mode. Revert keeps the original commit and adds an offsetting commit.

sections.title: Variants
sections.body: --soft git reset --soft HEAD~1 Undo the commit but keep the changes to restage them --hard git reset --hard HEAD~1 Move the branch to the previous commit and replace later tracked-file index and working-tree state; check first revert git revert a1b2c3d Undo a pushed commit without rewriting shared history

sections.title: Typical use cases

Reset --soft moves the branch but keeps staged changes git reset --soft HEAD~1 HEAD -> 3f9c2ab Adjust navigation spacing Branch pointer Moves to B Index Keeps C's changes staged Working files Keep C's changes Reset updates the branch, index, and working tree according to its mode. --hard replaces tracked working-tree changes, so check status first. Revert appends an offsetting commit to shared history Shared main · teammate D was committed after C 3f9c2ab B · Adjust navigation spacing a1b2c3d C · Add debug entry by mistake 9b8c7d6 D · Teammate updates help copy (HEAD, origin/main) Offset C git revert a1b2c3d New E Append Revert C after D This does not move shared C or the teammate's D. If later edits overlap with C, revert may also require manual conflict resolution. Recheck navigation and teammate changes remain Page recheck · keep B and D, remove C's effect History after the merge B Navigation update remains C Original commit stays in history D Teammate's help copy remains E Offsets C's debug entry my-first-page Home Work Help My portfolio Navigation and help copy remain; the debug entry is gone. Run the page and inspect affected paths. If revert overlaps later work, resolve the conflict too.

sections.title: From clone to start: when dependencies enter the project
sections.body: Just cloned Install dependencies Start the project my-first-page/ No node_modules yet package.json Records which packages are needed src/ node_modules/ Does not exist Terminal $ npm start Error: Cannot find module 'react' Dependencies are not installed yet The list is there but not the packages: install before starting For a missing module, separate three causes: never installed, version mismatch, or a wrong import path—each reports differently.

sections.title: Why dependencies need a separate install step
sections.body: The project stores a list, not the packages : The repository usually tracks a manifest and may track a lockfile; the install directory is commonly generated locally rather than committed. Installing prepares the local dependency directory : The package manager reads the manifest and lockfile, downloads or reuses required packages, and prepares a local install directory. A fresh clone or dependency change usually needs installation as documented by the project. Errors map to different causes : Cannot find module first suggests dependencies were never installed. If it persists after installing, check the version match and whether the import path is wrong.

sections.title: What each segment communicates
sections.body: Patch: usually a fix : For a stable public API, a patch change promises a compatible fix. Check the project's release notes and run its acceptance checks after upgrading. Minor: usually new features : For a stable public API, a minor release promises compatible additions; check whether the new features affect you. Major: possibly incompatible : For a stable public API, a major release signals incompatible changes; read the release notes before upgrading and verify your project flows afterward.

sections.title: Why a primary key must be unique
sections.body: Locate one row, not a batch : A primary key uniquely identifies a row; still inspect the write condition, affected-row count, and read-back result. A repeated field can match multiple rows. Ordinary fields repeat : Identical names and emails happen all the time; a primary key's values cannot repeat and cannot be empty. Tables link through it : When an orders table records which user an order belongs to, it stores the users table's primary key, not the name.

sections.title: Who can reach each kind of address
sections.body: localhost:3000 192.168.1.20:3000 203.0.113.7 localhost:3000 Loopback address Points to the device making the request Dev service on the computer Service computer · 192.168.1.20:3000 Computer browser → localhost:3000 → the computer's own loopback interface Can open: this example service runs on this computer Phone browser → localhost:3000 → the phone's own loopback interface Fails: this example phone is not running the dev service localhost always points to the device making the request. In this example the dev service runs on the computer and listens on its local port; the phone is not running it, so the phone's localhost cannot reach the computer. The dev service runs on the computer at 192.168.1.20:3000 on the LAN; localhost points to whichever device makes the request.

sections.title: Address scope decides who can reach it
sections.body: 127.0.0.1: only this machine : localhost and 127.0.0.1 mean this very computer; anyone else using the address reaches their own machine. LAN address: routed within a network : Private addresses such as 192.168.x.x and 10.x.x.x can be routed within their network; the service must also listen on a reachable interface, and firewall and network rules must allow the connection. A public address: potentially reachable from the internet : A public address can be routed from the internet, but connections still depend on ports, service listening, firewalls, and other access rules; a domain name resolves to an address.

zhSections.body: 过渡只有两态 ： 从初始状态到目标状态，由悬停、点击等切换触发，播放一次就停。 关键帧可以多态并循环 ： 在 @keyframes 写 0%、50%、100% 等状态点；要循环，还需另设 animation-iteration-count。 读代码找状态点 ： 百分比是作者指定的时间点；浏览器只会对可动画插值的属性计算中间值，不支持插值的属性可能离散切换。

zhDescription: 把小程序代码拆成主包和按需加载的分包的机制. 商城首页可以放在主包，退货与维修页放在售后分包，用户进入售后时再加载相关代码。这里下载的是页面代码与资源，不是向服务器读取订单数据。 也常被叫作小程序分包、代码分包、Subpackage。 VibeHub 可视化图解与使用边界 · 前端术语。

zhSections.title: 主包与分包怎样安排
zhSections.body: 入口与公共资源放主包 ： 入口页及普通分包共同需要的资源放在主包里，一项功能的页面与专属资源可以放入对应分包。 按进入的功能加载 ： 打开分包里的页面可以触发该包下载。预下载和缓存会改变实际时机，应该看下载记录确认，而不是凭感觉判断。
